job.job_description:
We are hiring a Full Stack Developer for our client. This is an excellent opportunity for a recent graduate to kick-start their career in software development, working closely with experienced professionals to build scalable, production-grade applications using in-demand technologies.




Role & responsibilities

Design, develop, and maintain web applications using Java/Python (backend) and React.js (frontend)
Build and consume RESTful APIs and microservices
Write efficient, reusable, and well-tested code following OOP principles
Work with relational and NoSQL databases (MySQL, PostgreSQL, MongoDB)
Debug, troubleshoot, and optimize application performance
Collaborate with QA, DevOps, and product teams in an Agile/Scrum environment
Assist in deploying applications on cloud platforms (AWS/Azure)
Participate in code reviews and follow secure coding best practices
Contribute to CI/CD pipelines and version control workflows (Git)
Continuously learn and adapt to new tools, frameworks, and industry practices



Preferred candidate profile

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, IT, or related field
Strong knowledge of Java or Python, and Object-Oriented Programming (OOP)
Good understanding of Data Structures & Algorithms
Basic to intermediate knowledge of React.js, HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript
Understanding of SQL and database concepts
Familiarity with REST APIs and microservices architecture
Basic knowledge of Git/GitHub for version control
Strong analytical, logical, and problem-solving skills
Good communication and teamwork abilities
